journey.title: Capture, retrieve, and triage a signal
journey.purpose: An operator captures external material, can find it in the permanent journal, and controls its ambient handling without deleting it.

steps.intent: Capture a URL, note, image, or local archive and inspect the resulting journal record.
steps.via: signal inbox capture and source adapter surfaces

steps.intent: Search the full immutable journal, including dropped material, with structured filters and continuation pages.
Review an ambient signal, inspect extracted text and annotations, then classify, annotate, accept, or drop it from ambient review.
